name: Tier list post
summary: A friend's post asking everyone to rank a few things into S to D tiers, with the feed's consensus revealed after you post.
useWhen: a post asking people to rank a handful of things
'rank the dining halls', 'tier list of campus coffee'
dontUseWhen: picking one winner (use a poll or bracket-post)

items.description: 2 to 6 things to rank: name and the feed's votes per tier [S, A, B, C, D] from outside this chat

people.description: Chat members who already posted: name and a tier letter per item
